text:
elaine (Docs): Heads-up: infra made Request-Id the canonical idempotency header for v2. We need a small migration note, updated snippets, and a checklist for customers.

omar (SDK): Acknowledge. Plan: accept both headers in SDK surface, prefer requestId param name, map idempotencyKey -> requestId internally and emit a single deprecation warning. I'll open PR.

elaine (Docs): Great. Keep snippets minimal. Also include raw HTTP and the exact Warning header string so Support can search logs.

trent (Examples): Our example apps use idempotencyKey in a few places. I'll swap them to requestId and leave a one-release compatibility shim with console.warn. PR: examples#420.

omar (SDK): Snippets for docs (feel free to adapt):

JS:
```js
// old
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-13b', prompt: 'Ping', idempotencyKey: uid })
// new
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-13b', prompt: 'Ping', requestId: uid })
```

Python:
```py
# old
client.generate(model='redwood-13b', prompt='Ping', idempotency_key=uid)
# new
client.generate(model='redwood-13b', prompt='Ping', request_id=uid)
```

elaine (Docs): Perfect. Raw HTTP for infra teams:
```http
POST /v2/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer $KEY
Request-Id: 9f8b7c6a-0000-4000-8000-abcdef123456
Content-Type: application/json

{"model":"redwood-13b","input":"..."}
```

elaine (Docs): Server will return this warning header if callers send Idempotency-Key: `Warning: 299 \"Idempotency-Key deprecated; use Request-Id\"`. Include that verbatim.

rhea (QA): I'll add two smoke tests in docs CI: (1) duplicate Request-Id -> second call deduped, (2) Idempotency-Key -> accepted + Warning header present. I need PR numbers to wire the tests.

omar (SDK): Draft PRs: SDK #8342 (mapping + warning), docs #8343 (migration blurb + snippets), smoke tests #8344. I'll update once pushed.

trent (Examples): I'll PR examples#420 within a few hours and tag reviewers.

support-bot: Support note suggested: search for Warning header text and advise customers to update middleware to emit Request-Id. I'll prepare KB after docs merge.

infra-bot: Canary deployed: v2 will emit Warning header when Idempotency-Key detected. Metric: idempotency_warning_rate -> #eng-sre.

elaine (Docs): Action items summary:
- omar: open SDK PR and include tiny snippets used by tests.
- trent: update example apps and README migration note.
- rhea: smoke tests + CI wiring once PRs exist.
- support-bot: KB draft after docs merge.
- me: update migration guide, add "how to verify" checklist and expected warning header text.

elaine (Docs): Timeline: aim to merge docs + SDK changes 48h before the public deprecation notice. Can everyone hit that?

omar (SDK): Yes, aiming for 36h. Will ping in thread when ready for review.

rhea (QA): I'll reserve CI window and queue smoke runs once PRs are open.

elaine (Docs): Thanks all — I'll open docs PR and paste these snippets. Ping me if anything changes. :thumbsup:
